purpose: Bounded ordinary W1L1 watch for the contact-child callback and its MAP-writing descendant; a negative result is route-scoped only.

method.input: KBD_right held for 8 guest frames before each sample

observations.effect_only_hits: The two 10B5 hits were on pooled objects whose callback was already 10B5; no 6328 or 16CE execution linked them to the player contact path.
observations.route: The sampled route advanced from the W1L1 start under right input and did not reach a contact-created 6328 child.

does_not_prove: that 6328 is unreachable during natural contact
that 16CE cannot rewrite a gameplay-relevant MAP cell
the indirect callback targets selected by 5937
next: Capture a natural or tightly controlled contact that actually allocates callback 6328, then watch 6328 and 16CE with MAP cell words before/after the write.
